bioAdditions: The 1910 census confirms the 1896 Bisaccia marriage: Francesco 'Janet', 41, said he had been married 14 years. He was then a contractor's laborer at 134 Sand Street, Dunmore, still an alien, living with his wife, the four children born in Italy (Sam, Marianna/Mariano, Marie and Tony) and two Italian boarders (S2). By January 1920 he owned the house at 133 Sand Street (with a mortgage) and worked as a laborer in the railroad shops. His sons Sam and Marion worked at a coal breaker, and the household had grown to seven children at home (S3). In May 1933 he was still living at 133 Sand Street when son Joseph married at St. Rocco's, the Guardiese church in Dunmore (S4). He died eleven months later. The state death index lists 'Francesco Giannett' of Dunmore, died 14 April 1934, file number 36353 (S1). By 1940 his widow was head of the household (S5).
